title: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East

sense.text:
This week, after the so-called peace deal in the war between America, Israel and Iran, the synagogues of Satan bombed Lebanon, killing women and children, the same thing they did in Palestine. Some feel sorry for the Lebanese people. The scriptures show why: the synagogues of Satan are doing God’s will.

“Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus”. Libanus is Lebanon. What God wants is for them “to turn themselves one against another”: all of them, Lebanon with them, fighting and killing each other, “and repay the things that they have done to them”, the things they have done to the Israelites.

So when you see Iran, America and all these wars taking place, the Lord is behind it. When little children are bombed it plays on a man’s emotions, because we have children too. But we have to understand it is God’s judgment. The Lord is the one doing these things on the earth.

“Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen”. Even in the time of Ezra, Lebanon and all the nations we were among were dealing evil with us. The Lord told Ezra that the same wickedness he saw in his own day was being done to his chosen, and that in the future he would repay them, bringing all of them to fight against each other and kill each other.

That is why we do not cry for these nations when they are bombed. The Arabs took all of North Africa by force; don’t freaking cry for these people when they are getting the hell bombed out of them. Remember what the scripture says: as they have done even till this day to the chosen, so will the Lord do to them.

precepts.why:
“Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof”. Tyrus, or Tyre, was a city in Lebanon, so this is talking about Lebanon. The three and the four go with the scripture that visits the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation: this is a generational curse. God is going to punish Lebanon, and that judgment is generational.

Why? “because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom”. The Lebanese people delivered us up to Edom, the white man. They had a role in our enslavement too. They hide these histories and we forgot, but God never forgets.

They also “remembered not the brotherly covenant”. We had a covenant with the people of Lebanon; they had to pay us tribute. They broke it, so God said he would bring judgment on them.

“But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.” That is what is taking place today: missiles and bombs dropped on Lebanon, devouring the cities over there.

“Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon”. This is concerning Lebanon. It is the prophets, and us, speaking after we are delivered from America: Lebanon is rejoicing, “saying, Since thou art laid down”, since America and Israel, the king of Babylon, are destroyed.

“no feller is come up against us.” Until then America and Israel will keep fighting with Lebanon. From time to time they will keep bombing and destroying Lebanon, and try to do to Lebanon what they did to Palestine.

Palestine has been conquered. There will be no two-state solution in the land of Israel: a yoke will be put on the Palestinians and they will be kept in a prison camp, and the Israelis will always control Palestine. If a Palestinian government is ever set up, it will be puppets.

sense.text:
“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many”. That is what America does, and what Trump is doing. He said he would not start wars but stop them; then he said he would bring Iran back to the stone ages. He keeps talking about setting up peace, but he is dropping bombs and murdering world leaders and civilizations on the earth. While you are negotiating peace with him, he will bomb the hell out of you and kill you. That is what took place in Lebanon this week: a peace deal was announced, and the following day the synagogues bombed the hell out of the Lebanese people. These things have to take place, and the Lord is behind them. Trump is fulfilling God’s will.

The Iranians are not like the Arab countries. They are the Persians, Elam, very smart people, and they showed the US government, we are not the ones to f with.

“he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”. The Prince of princes is the Lord Christ: he will stand up against Christ. “but he shall be broken without hand.” He is going to be broken. That is a future prophecy. It is not only talking about Antiochus in the past: Antiochus, the same system he set up, is going to be back in these last days.

Things are speeding up. As the time draws near we can tell how far away we are from the return of our King, and we do not have long.

“Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand”. God declares the end from the beginning. From ancient times, two, three, four thousand years ago, he let us know the things that were not yet done. So if he declared the end from the beginning, would he not let us know about Islam rising up in the future? He did. The Lord God recorded Islam rising up and our people following after Islam, and he said it is wrong and we should not do it.

Islam, being a Muslim, is the Arab man’s religion. There are three kinds. The Sunni and the Shiite are real Islam. The Nation of Islam, the brothers in bow ties selling bean pies and newspapers on the corner, is a bootleg copy of the original; much of what it does was made up and has nothing to do with being a real Muslim. The Sunni and the Shia split in the seventh century over who should lead after Muhammad’s death: the Sunnis, most Muslims, elect their leaders, the caliphs, and the Shia believe leadership belongs to divine, infallible descendants of Muhammad’s family.

The Nation of Islam was started on July 4, 1930 in Detroit by Wallace Fard Muhammad, who looked like a white man. After him came Elijah Muhammad, and then Minister Louis Farrakhan, who leads it to this day; when he passes, that will likely be the end of it. It was started to improve the condition of our people in America when the white man was lynching and killing us: brothers said, I won’t follow the white man’s religion, and followed the Arab man’s religion instead. It had good values, no pork and no drinking, and in the 1930s through the 60s it gave our people pride, discipline and the confidence to stand up against the white man. Some brothers, like Malcolm X, became Muslims in prison, for protection. But it carried our people into idolatry. We should not be following Muslims: Muslim was not set up as a religion for everyone.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”. The prophecy is that the twelve tribes of Israel, the children of the slave trade, will be scattered among all people. “and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known”: scattered as slaves, we would serve gods that neither we nor our forefathers knew about.

“even wood and stone.” We read that often, but it is very specific about the gods we would serve, scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. The wood is the cross: Christianity. That cross represents the image of the beast, the white man’s religion. The stone is the Kaaba stone in Mecca. Being a Muslim, you are following that stone: you make the Hajj at least once in your life, and you bow and kiss that black stone.

Those are the two biggest religions on the earth, Christianity and Islam, each with billions of people, and our people are caught up in both. That is why it mentions those two religions, wood and stone. Moses saw our people caught up in these religions today.

“And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind”. That is what happened to our people in the lands where we were made slaves.

precepts.why:
“They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children”. Their spot is not the spot of God’s children: we don’t look like God’s children. The spot is how you are supposed to look. The Lord says, I do not recognize you; you don’t look like my children. Why? Because we are calling ourselves Muslims and calling ourselves Christians. The apostles of old were called Christians, but calling yourself a Christian today is following white supremacy.

“they are a perverse and crooked generation. Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise?” We are that perverse and crooked generation.

“They sacrificed unto devils”. The sacrifice is the worship. Praying five times a day every time you hear the call, fasting and praying in Ramadan, making the Hajj: that is how you sacrifice today, and you are sacrificing unto devils. The same goes for the brothers and sisters in Christianity who worship and pray to the white man.

“not to God”. All the praying and the Hajj are done for Allah, and that Allah is devils. It is not the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, though they say it is. That is for the Christians and the Muslims both.

“to gods whom they knew not”: our forefathers never knew about a white Caucasian Jesus, or Islam, or a Kaaba stone. “to new gods that came newly up”. Christianity is a new god that came about in the 1400s, the Renaissance, the rebirth of the white man’s rule in Europe. Islam was formed in the seventh century: around 610 Muhammad said he got the revelation, in 622 he migrated, and through that century Muslims spread all over, six hundred years after our King Christ, the black Messiah, died for our sins. Both are new religions on this earth.

“whom your fathers feared not.” Our forefathers never feared any rock.

“And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted”. This is what God is going to say. The rock our people trusted in is that same Kaaba stone, because that is what being a Muslim is really about: you have to go to Mecca and kiss that rock. Idol worshippers. They say they are not worshipping it, that they only make the Hajj for the blessing of Allah: you know how the damn Muslims be talking. “Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices”.

Our people have been Muslims for close to a century now. Has our condition in Babylon changed? No. Our people are still oppressed, still living in broken conditions, still the bottom of society. One or two may be millionaires, but as a nation of people we are still destroyed. Being a Muslim did not help us, and the Nation of Islam, the bootleg version of being a real Muslim, did not help us.

sense.text:
“Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness”. We were always known for sitting and learning from the Arabians, the Arabs. We are not to learn the Arab religion, the same way we are not to learn the Chinese religion or the white man’s religion.

Islam is the Arabs’ religion, the same way the white man has his white Jesus and the Chinese have Buddha, and over the years we followed the religion of whichever nation conquered and colonized us. Islam began in Arabia around 610 with Muhammad’s teachings, grew after the migration to Medina in 622, and after his death in 632 spread as an empire across Syria, Egypt, Persia and North Africa, and from Spain to Central Asia.

How did it expand? Through the trans-Saharan slave trade, from the seventh century into the twentieth: more than twelve hundred years, longer than the Atlantic trade, with ten to twenty million carried out of Africa to North Africa and the Middle East. When that religion came about, they began conquering and enslaving our people. Our people who call themselves Muslims openly and willingly today had it forced on them by conquest, slavery and colonization. The white man ended his slave trade because of how he looked to the world; the Arabs never ended it, and they enslave our people in their countries to this day. It is in their law that it is okay to enslave black people, the Israelites. So do not let these Muslims tell you they love black people. The Nation of Islam refused the white man’s religion and followed the Arab man’s religion, and the Arabs did to our people the same thing the white man did.

Sudan, Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco, Mauritania and Somalia were occupied by the children of Ham. Today Ishmael occupies them. The same way the white man conquered and colonized Africa in the name of Jesus, the Arabs came in the seventh, eighth and ninth centuries and conquered, killed and took the land in the name of Allah. Now they say they are the real Egyptians, when the Egyptians are the sons of Ham. They stole that land the same way the synagogues of Satan stole the land of Israel, so when they cry against greater Israel, the Arabs have no moral ground to stand on.
“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.” The Arabs conquered all of North Africa, and our people living in those places were enslaved.

“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult”. Enemies is plural: God has a lot of enemies on this earth that hate him, and they are mentioned by name. A tumult is a loud gathering.

“and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” To lift up the head is to begin to rule. Often we teach this as the white man coming into power in the 1400s and changing everything up, even who the real Jews are. But we forget when Ishmael lifted up his head. In the seventh century Ishmael began ruling and conquering: he enslaved us in Africa, stole all those lands, and forced Islam on our people wherever he went, the same way the white man in the 1400s forced Christianity on people wherever he went.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” It was not the white man alone that took crafty counsel to destroy us from who we are, our nationality, so that we would forget it. The Arabs did it too: Ishmael did it.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation”. Who said it? Not just Esau: Ishmael is there too. Ishmael and all nations played a role in cutting us off from being a nation, not just the white man.

“that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” Look around the world today and ask who the Israelites are, and you will rarely find brothers who know they are Israelites, except by us today, or a remnant who know but have forgotten the customs and the laws. That was war. The Arabs destroyed us from being a nation; the so-called white man destroyed us; the Chinese destroyed us. All nations came together in that secret counsel to destroy us and our remembrance all over the world.

“For they have consulted together with one consent”: they all agree. “they are confederate against thee: The tabernacles of Edom”: the number one enemy of God, the so-called Caucasian race. “and the Ishmaelites”: the second enemy of God, these damn Arabs. Then Moab and the Hagarenes, and the Chinese, number three on God’s hit list, always celebrating the year of the snake and the year of the dragon. The day of the Lord will come and destroy them.

They took our identity from us and forced their religion on us, and all nations were in agreement in what they did to us. So when you see the Lord bringing judgment on these Arabs, bombing the hell out of them, stay out of the Lord’s business. We forgot what they did to us a thousand years, five hundred years, a hundred years ago, as it says, that the name of Israel be no more in remembrance. But the Lord sees everything, he does not forget, and he is going to judge them.

The Arabs say all the prophets came through Israel, but that the last prophet was Muhammad and God is now dealing with the Arabs. The scriptures prove God never dealt and is not dealing with the Arabs.

“Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt”. God is speaking to the children of Israel.

“You only have I known of all the families of the earth”. You have Moabites, Ishmaelites, Hittites, all the families of the earth, and God says, you Israelites are the only ones I know, the only ones I deal with out of all the families on the earth. The Bible does not contradict itself.

That is why the synagogues of Satan run around claiming to be the Jews, God’s chosen people. They are not; they are the synagogue of Satan. God’s chosen people were enslaved and scattered throughout the four corners of the earth.

“therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.” That punishment was slavery, oppression, the things we go through as a people today.

precepts.why: “Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” The prophets only come through Israel. Muhammad was not a prophet, and God showed him nothing.

“He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.” God shows his word, his statutes and his judgments only to Israel. “He hath not dealt so with any nation”: no other family, no other nation on the earth. “and as for his judgments, they have not known them.” The nations don’t understand God’s judgments.

Then how the hell do these Arabs know what is clean and what is unclean, what is halal and what is haram? They rehearse. The word Quran means to rehearse or to recite, and what they recite is what the Lord showed us: much of what Islam follows is written in the Bible.

Nobody was around when Abraham did what he did. The only way anyone knows about Abraham and Ishmael is that God showed it to Moses in a vision and Moses recorded it. The Arabs have no records three or four thousand years old proving they descend from Ishmael. Their religion came six hundred years after Christ; they learned who they are from us. Ishmael learned God’s judgments from the prophets: they read the Bible, copied much of it and formed their own religion, no different from the white man, who formed his own religion using the letters of Paul.

“And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel”. That is who God is going to be in the midst of. “and that I am the Lord your God”: your God is possessive. “and none else”. He is nobody else’s God: not the Ishmaelites’ God, not the Moabites’ God.

Why does the Lord have to say that? Because everybody says God is dealing with them and God is their God. Ishmael runs around saying Allahu akbar, and the Caucasians in the land of Israel say Hashem gave them the land and they will kill all the Arabs there. But the day is coming when it will be known that God is our God, and none else.

sense.text:
Muhammad said an angel came and gave him the revelation of the Quran. Remember that Deuteronomy 32 says we sacrificed unto devils.

“a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying”. She was a witch. She had the spirit of divination, the same way Balaam had the spirit of divination and could see things in the future. This woman had a devil on her and could see things. There are evil spirits with these kinds of powers, to certain limits.

“The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.” The demon in her was following Paul and the apostles. It could see who they were.

“And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.” Paul rebuked the spirit, the devil she was possessed with, and it came out.

Muhammad claimed to see things and have revelations. It would be no surprise if evil spirits were dealing with him, the spirit of a devil, the same way that soothsaying spirit knew things about the apostles and Balaam saw things that were not God showing him. And it is not only the white man who has the spirit of a devil.

If an angel or anybody comes and tells you anything different, don’t listen to them. Even if what they tell you comes to pass, don’t follow them: it is not the spirit of God on that person but the spirit of a devil, and it could be the Lord proving you, to see whether you will trust in him or in that devil.

precepts.why: “With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.” The deceiver and the deceived both belong to the Lord. The deceiver, Islam, came up on the earth in the seventh century and began deceiving the world, and the Lord allowed it to happen. He allowed that religion to be created because it goes hand in hand with his prophecies and the things that have to take place.

sense.text: “And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.” Ishmael was mocking Isaac. Even till this day the Arabs mock us: they come to America, open corner stores, make money, then look down on black people and mock us.

“Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.” Get rid of this bondwoman and her son; he is not going to get any inheritance with Isaac.

“And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.” It was hard for Abraham, because every man loves his sons. Abraham did not want to send him away, so God had to intervene: “Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad”. I know it is hard; nobody wants to get rid of their child. “in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice”: listen to her.

“for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.” The righteous seed, the prophets, would come through Isaac. So send away the bondwoman and the child Ishmael.
“And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.” Don’t worry about your son, Abraham: Ishmael is going to become a nation.

“And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away”. Abraham sent Ishmael away, the father of the Arabs, with a bottle of water and some bread.

That is important, because the Arabs like to talk about being descendants of Abraham and the Abrahamic religions. Abraham gave you a bottle of water and some bread and said get the hell away from me.

“And God heard the voice of the lad”, and the angel of God said to Hagar, “Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.” God said he would make Ishmael a great nation.

“And God was with the lad; and he grew”. God was with Ishmael, and Ishmael grew. “and dwelt in the wilderness”: the wilderness is the desert. He dwelt in the desert, in the sand.

“and became an archer.” He became a warrior. Ishmael was a warrior.

“And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran”. Paran is over by Mount Sinai and the Sinai peninsula, not far from Egypt. “and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.”
“I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.” “Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.” Hagar fled because Sarai was beating her for being disrespectful.

“I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.” That goes into Ishmael: Ishmael would not be able to be numbered. Look how many Arabs there are all over the world today. That is prophecy.

“Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael”. This is before chapter 21, while Ishmael was still in the womb. “because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.” Ishmael means affliction heard, and his name is important to prophecy: it goes into future prophecy.

“And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man”. Why? Because, as chapter 21 shows, he was a warrior, an archer skilled with the bow. “and every man’s hand against him”. That happened back then, but it is also future prophecy concerning Ishmael, concerning the Arabs. It is why Islam came about: God told Ishmael he would fight against every man.

“and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.”

precepts.why:
“Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham”. Then the names of his sons: “the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar”, and the rest. Kedar is the Saudi Arabians today. “These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.” Ishmael had twelve princes, and they all had nations.

That is how he dwells in the presence of all his brethren: in the wilderness, the Arabian desert, Saudi Arabia and the land around it. Ishmael always dwelt in the desert, among each other. That was their original land, until in the seventh and eighth centuries they began conquering parts of Africa and expanding their reach, forcing Islam on everyone.

Pay attention to the twelve princes. Twelver Shia Islam holds as a core pillar that there are twelve divinely appointed imams, twelve successors from Muhammad, ending in a twelfth, hidden imam who disappeared in the ninth century and will return in the last days. He is the Mahdi, the guided one. The Sunnis do not believe in that hidden imam, but their hadiths, writings that break down Muhammad’s words, say a Mahdi will be born in the future and appear before the end times. So the Sunni and the Shiite are both expecting a Mahdi to come, an anointed one they say comes before Christ returns. The same way Balaam was shown certain things, Muhammad was shown certain things by a demon.

sense.text:
“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Prepared for what? For battle, for war against Israel.

The kings of the east are the nations east of the Euphrates: Iraq, Iran, parts of Turkey and Syria, and Persia a little further east. All of them are Muslims, and all of them are waiting on the one they call the Mahdi, their leader.

Muhammad’s so-called prophecy says that when you see black flags coming from Khorasan, join that army even if you have to crawl over ice, because it is the army of the Mahdi. Khorasan is the area of Iran, Pakistan and Afghanistan. Iran are Shiite Muslims who believe in the twelfth imam, and when the war began they raised black flags at their borders, because of that belief. The army of the Mahdi is the army that is going to start the third war. The Muslims say the Mahdi will come in a time of chaos and injustice, unite the Muslims and lead them to victory against tyranny and oppression. Muhammad was no prophet: he rehearsed what he saw in the Bible, and devils were with him and showed him things. These Arabs take Bible prophecy and fit it to their own narratives.

The kings of the east are all Muslims joining together, not Ishmael alone: Iran is not Ishmael. But Ishmael is the one that will set it off. Even the Iranians understand that the Mahdi will be an Arab, and they will support him. All the weapons the Ayatollah and them are preparing are to fight against Israel and America. When they say death to America and death to Israel, it is not only because they are being bombed: their prophecy says the Mahdi will return and destroy Israel and America. That is what real Muslims, the Sunni and the Shiite, believe, not the Muslims here in America. Marco Rubio said it: they recruit fighters to be part of an army to trigger a final showdown between the West and Islam, under the twelfth imam, and you cannot negotiate with people who have that apocalyptic vision. You cannot reason with real Muslims. These people are crazy, and God created them that way.

“And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” That goes into their politics, their economics and their religion. The three unclean spirits are oppression: they put sanctions on countries, they force their religion on countries, and the people in the land say, we are the Jews, this land belongs to us.

These spirits are getting all the nations of the earth mad and preparing them for war. Trump came into office and put tariffs on all nations; America went and bombed Iran, Iran cut off the oil supply, and the rest of the world is suffering because of what America did.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.” That is the apocalyptic event Marco Rubio was talking about, and Islam is also preparing for that great day.

“Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments”. Watch what is going on, wait for the return of Christ, and keep your garments: don’t be in the midst of sin with filthy garments on. “lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.” The Lord comes back and sees your shame, and you are in the midst of adultery.

“And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.” Armageddon is a place. Megiddo comes from ancient Canaanite roots and means a place of troops, a rendezvous, a city of military importance. Armageddon comes from Har Megiddo, the mount of Megiddo. It is the place where all the armies are going to be gathered together.

Where is it? Megiddo today is Tel Megiddo, at the western end of the Jezreel Valley in northern Israel. So Armageddon is modern-day Israel. Megiddo was a Canaanite land, one of the lands we took from the Canaanites, part of the land of Israel. That is where the armies are going, and where the one they call the Mahdi is going. Why will he gather everybody there? Because according to Muslim prophecy that land has to be taken: the Mahdi will lead all Muslims together to take the land of Israel and destroy the Israelis in it. Armageddon is not in China, and it is not in Europe.

precepts.why:
“One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.” The woes are the world wars. “Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.” That is the same Euphrates of the sixth vial. Those angels are holding back that third war.

“And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.” A third of eight billion: about two and a half billion people will die in the beginning of that war, before Christ even starts his killing. “And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand”.

There will be a build-up to that final war once the angels are loosed, and its finale is one hour: America will be destroyed in one hour. After that war, they still have to come and fight against Christ.

“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. Edom is the so-called Caucasian race, the Europeans. “We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.”

Who is going to be the first to rise up against Israel and America? The Muslims, under the one the Arabs call the Mahdi. That ambassador is a leader who will rise among the Arabs and gather all Muslims together, not only Arabs: Pakistan, Iran. That is why, in 2 Esdras 15, the Carmanians join with them: they believe the same thing. It will happen because of the oppression and affliction on the Arabs: the greater Israel plan, wanting part of Saudi Arabia, Syria and Lebanon, and all the blood the Israeli government and America shed murdering those people. Eventually those people will rise up.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” Israel and America will be greatly hated. You see it taking place today: all the Arabs, Spain, all nations say these people are evil for carpet bombing everybody with no remorse. But the Lord is behind all of that. Let them keep afflicting Ishmael so the Mahdi, that leader, can rise up; that leader might be Ishmael coming back. He will say, let us rise up against them in battle, and that is the beginning of the war.

“For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem, I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat”. The valley of Jehoshaphat is the land of Israel, and it is also called Armageddon: all nations are going to go down there to fight the synagogues of Satan.

“and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” The land is parted today between the Palestinians and the people that call themselves Jews and are not. Armageddon is where all the armies will be gathered to fight against the land of Israel. The third woe will take place in the land of Israel.
